findings.answer: Effective for the Consolidated Entity from 1 April 2027, applied retrospectively; impact being assessed
findings.evidence: In June 2024, the Australian Accounting Standards Board (AASB) issued AASB 18 Presentation and Disclosure in Financial Statements (AASB 18).
